name: DEVLIFE / 36-quarter full database
desc: 实际 PostgreSQL 18.6 元数据；完整 36 季度软件。

tables.name: public.users
tables.comment: 用户：预置玩家和管理员；归属与授权由服务端核验

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 用户唯一标识，由数据库生成 UUID

columns.name: username
columns.comment: 登录名，区分大小写，去空白后长度 3–32，唯一

columns.name: password_hash
columns.comment: scrypt 口令哈希，含算法参数和随机盐，禁止保存明文

columns.name: role
columns.comment: 用户角色：player 玩家 / admin 管理员

columns.name: auth_version
columns.comment: 会话失效版本，非负整数，修改口令后递增

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 创建时间，带时区

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)

indexes.name: users_username_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_username_key ON public.users USING btree (username)

tables.name: public.events
tables.comment: 完整 36 季度游戏的事件目录；草稿和完整定义，已发布快照独立保存

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 事件草稿 UUID

columns.name: code
columns.comment: 稳定编码 event-源ID；与 source_id 唯一对应

columns.name: text
columns.comment: 事件叙述，非空文本

columns.name: choices
columns.comment: 原始选项 JSON 数组，含 id、label、description、event、condition、effect；并投影到 event_choices

columns.name: effects
columns.comment: 原引擎属性效果：CHR 沟通、INT 技术、STR 健康、MNY 积蓄、SPR 心态等；均为游戏点数

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: 草稿乐观锁版本，服务端用 expectedRevision 比较后递增

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 最近修改时间；服务端更新草稿时显式刷新

columns.name: source_id
columns.comment: TypeScript 原事件整数 ID，旧 24 季度条目可空

columns.name: definition
columns.comment: 完整原事件定义，保留 grade、dialogue、branch、choices、include、exclude、NoRandom 等

indexes.name: events_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON public.events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: events_code_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_code_key ON public.events USING btree (code)

indexes.name: events_source_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_source_id_key ON public.events USING btree (source_id)

tables.name: public.content_versions
tables.comment: 已发布的不可变内容快照；只允许插入和读取，包含全部事件、季度表及结局规则

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 内容版本 UUID，存档固定引用此版本

columns.name: snapshot
columns.comment: 完整 36 季度源内容：events、talents、achievements、characters、ages、endings、specialThanks 及格式版本

columns.name: checksum
columns.comment: 应用按键排序并序列化快照后计算的 SHA-256，小写十六进制

columns.name: created_by
columns.comment: 发布者用户 UUID，外键 RESTRICT；管理员权限在服务端核验

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 发布时间，带时区

columns.name: source_tag
columns.comment: 内容来源与格式标识，game36 表示当前软件完整内容

columns.name: career_quarters
columns.comment: 内容适用的季度总数，当前软件为 36

indexes.name: content_versions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_versions_pkey ON public.content_versions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: content_versions_checksum_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_versions_checksum_key ON public.content_versions USING btree (checksum)

indexes.name: content_versions_created_by_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX content_versions_created_by_idx ON public.content_versions USING btree (created_by)

constraints.name: content_versions_created_by_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: content_versions_immutable
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER content_versions_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.content_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_content_version_mutation()

triggers.name: content_versions_no_truncate
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER content_versions_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.content_versions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_content_version_mutation()

tables.name: public.career_runs
tables.comment: 职业生涯历史，保存当前 36 季度原引擎状态快照；客户端计算，服务端归档

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 存档 UUID

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: 存档所有者 UUID，服务端每次读写均核验归属

columns.name: content_version_id
columns.comment: 开局时固定的内容版本 UUID，后续发布不替换

columns.name: quarter
columns.comment: 原引擎已完成季度，当前软件 0 到 36

columns.name: state
columns.comment: 原 GameState 的 JSON 表示：props、life、talents、events、achievements、talentTriggers、pendingChoice、decisions

columns.name: rng_state
columns.comment: 随机状态标识；client-unavailable 表示客户端未提供可恢复随机状态

columns.name: status
columns.comment: ready、awaiting_choice、ended；当前接入保存的是 ended 生涯历史

columns.name: version
columns.comment: 当前归档记录的决定数量；进行中动作版本控制尚未接入

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 开局时间，带时区

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 最后成功保存时间，服务端显式更新

indexes.name: career_runs_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX career_runs_pkey ON public.career_runs USING btree (id)

indexes.name: career_runs_user_created_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX career_runs_user_created_idx ON public.career_runs USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: career_runs_content_version_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX career_runs_content_version_idx ON public.career_runs USING btree (content_version_id)

constraints.name: career_runs_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: career_runs_content_version_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (content_version_id) REFERENCES content_versions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.run_actions
tables.comment: 已结算动作与幂等结果：同存档同 request_id 只允许一条

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 动作记录 UUID

columns.name: run_id

columns.name: request_id
columns.comment: 调用方生成的幂等 UUID，重试必须复用

columns.name: payload_hash
columns.comment: 规范化业务载荷的 SHA-256，用于拒绝同键异载荷

columns.name: result
columns.comment: 原始选择决定及结果快照；客户端历史导入记录不等于服务端权威结算

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 成功提交时间，带时区

indexes.name: run_actions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_actions_pkey ON public.run_actions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: run_actions_request_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_actions_request_unique ON public.run_actions USING btree (run_id, request_id)

constraints.name: run_actions_run_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES career_runs(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
